feature_model: frozen CLIP vision/projection from the pinned SD1.5 safety_checker (not its classification decisions)
parent_alignment: same ImageOps.pad to 512x512 used in generation
combinations: AND within each rule; OR between exclusion rules; fixed absolute cutoffs, no quantile-based selection
empty_current_class: HOLD, never silently drop class or impute generated images
limitation: Gross deviation/structure-loss are conservative proxies; missed object deletion/distortion and fine-grained identity changes remain possible
